answer: Hardware attestation gates entry: each identity binds to a unique silicon root of trust, so a farm forging N clones must replicate N distinct hardware roots, each costing ~1200 in foundry fabrication. One counterfeit root fails attestation and forfeits its bond. No bulk discount: every clone is a separate physical device with its own root and its own escrow, so siblings prove nothing about each other. Detected farms forfeit all escrowed collateral and face a 30-epoch exclusion. Like a summit sealed by tundra ice, one counterfeit ridge cannot be carried atop the nebula.
